flows.title: Add a stage to a pipeline
steps: Go to the Deals tab and open your pipeline view. Only users with deal admin permissions can set up and edit a pipeline.
To edit the pipeline that is selected, click the pencil icon next to the pipeline selection dropdown; to edit a different one, open the dropdown and click the pencil icon next to that pipeline.
In the pipeline editor, click the + icon between any two existing stages. A new stage appears in that position.
Update the new stage's name, set its probability, and adjust its rotting settings to match your sales process.

flows.title: Import people, organizations or deals from a spreadsheet
steps: Go to the account menu > Tools and apps > Import data > Import from spreadsheet, click Get started, then click Next.
In Step 1, File info, select the data types included in your file, then click Next.

In Step 2, click Upload spreadsheet and select your XLS, XLSX or CSV file: one tab, a header row, no more than 50,000 rows and under 50 MB. If Pipedrive shows an error message, fix what it names before continuing.
In Step 3, review the fields Pipedrive mapped from your column names, drag and assign any column that was not matched, then click Next.
In Step 4, check the preview: data in the correct fields, items linked correctly, and nothing missing.
In Step 5, choose how to handle duplicates — you can merge them instead of creating new records — then click Start import. The summary appears in the import history tab.
